transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: S-Net technical support, Kevin. Account number?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yeah, it's 520-664-871. The name on it is Patricia Alvarez.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Right, it's pulled up. What's the problem.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So, honestly I'm really frustrated. My internet has been dead for two days and I work from home, so I'm losing money. It's been going on and getting worse, and it always cuts out at the worst possible time. I've tried the obvious stuff already and nothing works.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. So it's down.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: ...yes. It's down. That's why I'm calling.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just reboot it. Unplug it, wait, plug it back in.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay... unplugging it now... waiting... plugging it back in. The lights are coming back on.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: ...okay it's back on, but it's still doing the same thing. Nothing's changed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Well, do it again then.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I've done it twice now. It's exactly the same.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What do the lights on it look like.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: There are a few lights... some green, one's kind of orange I think? I'm not really sure what they're supposed to be.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. Hold on a sec.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: ...are you still there?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yeah. Still here.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Look, I really need this sorted, I've explained the problem twice now. Is there something else we can actually try here?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Change your DNS to 8.8.8.8.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay... I've gone into the settings and changed the DNS to 8.8.8.8 and saved it.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That didn't do anything either. It's still cutting out.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: To be honest this is really the manufacturer's equipment playing up, not our network. But we can keep trying I suppose.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: ...I'd just like it working, whoever's fault it is.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Try turning the Wi-Fi off and on on your device.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, toggled it off and back on. Still the same, still dropping.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Try a different cable if you have one.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I've swapped it for another cable I had in the drawer. Made no difference at all, it's still exactly the same problem.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: This is the third or fourth thing now and nothing's working. I've already been on this call a while and I'm getting nowhere.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me just check something. Hold on.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: ...okay. Still waiting.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yeah. Try disabling the firewall temporarily.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I turned it off for a second... no change... I've turned it back on because I wasn't comfortable leaving it off.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Fine. Hold on again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, do a full power-cycle of the modem this time. Off for thirty seconds, then on.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay... it's off... waiting the thirty seconds... turning it back on now. Lights are coming up one by one.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh - okay, hang on. It actually seems to be working now. Pages are loading and it hasn't dropped.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yeah, it's definitely working now, that seems to have done it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, so it's working now. I'll put a note on the account.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Alright. Thanks I suppose.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Anything else? No? Okay. Goodbye.
